description: This file is a PHP source script for the vtiger CRM system that retrieves organization details from the database, prepares variables, and renders a template named 'Settings/CompanyInfo.tpl'. It manages organization information such as name, address, contact details, logo, and logo path, and assigns these variables to a Smarty template engine for display.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM.
